device_description: Al/CdSe-ZnS core-shell QD/AlOx/CdSe-ZnS core-shell QD/ITO, 2-terminal resistive memory
source_doi_or_citation: Kannan V., Rhee J.K. (2013). Robust switching characteristics of CdSe/ZnS quantum dot non-volatile memory devices. Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 15, 12762-12766. DOI: 10.1039/c3cp50216c
notes: CdSe/ZnS is the closest real-world analog to a Type I core/shell system in this project's schema (2-terminal, charge-trapping). hysteresis_window_V not reported in available excerpt -- left blank, not estimated. retention_time_s=20000 is the tested/observed stability duration ('stable for over 20,000 s'), not a fitted/extrapolated lifetime -- do not treat as equivalent to the 10-year-style projections in the other rows below. on_off_ratio ~1000 (order-of-magnitude as reported, not exact).

device_description: Ti-TiOx/CdSe-ZnS core-shell QD, bipolar 2-terminal nonvolatile resistive memory
source_doi_or_citation: Kannan V., Kim H.S., Park H.C. (2016). High speed switching in quantum Dot/Ti-TiOx nonvolatile memory device. Electronic Materials Letters. DOI: 10.1007/s13391-015-5410-5
notes: Same CdSe/ZnS core-shell QD family as the row above, different device stack (adds a Ti-TiOx layer). hysteresis_window_V and a numeric retention_time_s were NOT found in available search excerpts -- retention is only described qualitatively ('good retention characteristics under stress'); both left blank rather than guessed. Reports switching speed ~15 ns and endurance to 100,000 cycles (neither is in this project's 3-target schema, noted for context only). on_off_ratio=100 as reported.

device_description: CdSe@CdS core-shell QD floating-gate layer on monolayer MoS2 transistor memory
source_doi_or_citation: Core-shell quantum dot-enabled monolayer MoS2 memories with high endurance. Matter (Cell Press), 2025. DOI: 10.1016/j.matt.2025.102488
notes: IMPORTANT CAVEATS: (1) CdSe/CdS is generally reported in the literature as a quasi-Type-II system, not a clean Type I system like CdSe/ZnS -- band alignment does not cleanly match this project's 'Type I core-shell' framing. (2) This is a 3-terminal floating-gate TRANSISTOR memory, not a 2-terminal resistive-switching device -- 'memory window' (140 V) is a gate-voltage hysteresis, a different physical quantity from this project's 2-terminal hysteresis_window_V (which spans roughly 0-1.1 V in the synthetic dataset); do not directly numerically compare the two without accounting for device architecture. retention_time_s=315360000 is 10 years converted to seconds, per the paper's reported '96.5% charge retention over 10 years' -- this is very likely a short-term-measurement-then-extrapolated industry-standard projection (common practice), not a 10-year continuous measurement; flagged, not verified from full text (only abstract/excerpt available). Full author list not confirmed from available search results -- cite by DOI. Also reports endurance >5e4 cycles (outside this project's 3-target schema, noted for context only).

device_description: CdS nanoribbon / CH3NH3PbBr3 perovskite nanocrystal core-shell hybrid, floating-gate transistor memory
source_doi_or_citation: High-Performance Nanofloating Gate Memory Based on Lead Halide Perovskite Nanocrystals. ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces 11(27), 24367-24377 (2019). DOI: 10.1021/acsami.9b03474
notes: IMPORTANT CAVEATS: (1) This is a nanoribbon/nanocrystal hybrid heterostructure, not a spherical core-radius+shell-thickness core-shell nanocrystal as modeled by this project's geometry features (core_radius_nm, shell_thick_nm) -- geometric mismatch, use with care. (2) Also a 3-terminal floating-gate transistor, same 'memory window vs hysteresis_window_V' unit/architecture caveat as the row above (77.4 V gate-voltage window, not directly comparable to this project's ~0-1.1 V 2-terminal scale). (3) CdS/CH3NH3PbBr3 band alignment not established as Type I in the cited work. retention_time_s=12000 IS reported as a direct measured value ('long retention time of 12,000 s'), not an extrapolation -- more directly usable than the Matter-2025 row's 10-year figure. Full author list not confirmed from available search results -- cite by DOI. on_off_ratio=7e7 as reported (7 x 10^7).
